prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A small ink glyph — a stylized rectangular card tilted slightly with a
corner fold suggested by a single diagonal line. Warm gilt ink.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor archival plate on aged parchment — a stylized playing card glyph, rectangular form tilted at a slight angle, rendered in warm gilt ink against vellum cream with slate ink shadow accents.

subjects.type: icon glyph — tilted rectangle with corner fold
subjects.description: Bold rectangular card silhouette, slight clockwise tilt, single diagonal line at upper corner suggesting a folded edge, crisp nib-pen linework, minimal fills
Aged parchment ground, faint foxing at margins, warm vellum grain beneath the glyph
